pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Lets you lift creatures and blocks at a distance, change their distance from you, and throw them.$(br2)$(bold)$(#7952A6)Requirement:$() Path level 15.

pages.title: Use and limits
pages.text: Look at a creature or block and hold the ability key to lift it; use the mouse wheel to change distance. Release or press the key again to throw it. Creatures take damage when they hit blocks. Blocks with inventories or hardness above $(thing)touchBlockMaxHardness$() cannot be lifted.
